summary: In modules, wrap third-party imports in try/except saving a HAS_ flag and traceback, then call module.fail_json with missing_required_lib and the saved exception when the library is missing.
questions: How do I handle a missing Python library in my module?

answer_card.title: Guarding imports in modules
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
import traceback
from ansible.module_utils.basic import missing_required_lib

try:
    import another_library
except ImportError:
    HAS_ANOTHER_LIBRARY = False
    ANOTHER_LIBRARY_IMPORT_ERROR = traceback.format_exc()
else:
    HAS_ANOTHER_LIBRARY = True
    ANOTHER_LIBRARY_IMPORT_ERROR = None

# in main():
module = AnsibleModule(...)
if not HAS_ANOTHER_LIBRARY:
    module.fail_json(msg=missing_required_lib('another_library'),
                     exception=ANOTHER_LIBRARY_IMPORT_ERROR)
```
